name: Divider
description: Visual separator between sections (horizontal or vertical).

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-05 — beta→stable (fleet #12): renders a real <hr> (contract element corrected div→hr). decorative default role=none; decorative={false} announces role=separator + aria-orientation. No motion; single hairline on --color-border. Re-verified independently: axe + plays green in light/dark/forced-colors, 100% controls operable / 0 inert, AT snapshots refreshed 4 modes. 2026-05-28 origin: promoted from alpha with Example + ForcedColors stories and the Storybook axe gate.

forbiddenUse: Use a divider as spacing — reach for gap or Spacer when you only need distance.
Put a divider between every list row — List's own rhythm and borders handle that.
dense: hr separator on border tokens: orientation horizontal|vertical; decorative=true (default) removes it from the AT tree (role=none), decorative=false announces role=separator + aria-orientation

usage.description: Divider draws a rule on the production border tokens. By default it is decorative — `role="none"`, invisible to assistive tech — which is right when it only supports visual rhythm. Set `decorative={false}` when the rule conveys real structure (menu groups, toolbar clusters) so AT users get the same grouping. Vertical dividers need a height from their flex row.

bestPractices.description: Keep the decorative default when the rule is visual rhythm only.
Set decorative={false} where the split carries meaning (menu groups) so the separator role is announced.
Give vertical dividers a height via the parent row (align-self stretch or explicit class).
Space it with the parent's gap or margin utilities on className, not wrapper divs.
Do not put a divider between every list row — List's own rhythm and borders handle that.
Do not use dividers as spacing; if you only need distance, use gap or Spacer.
